Translation.llm_provider_tips.ollama:
##### Ollama Configuration
- **API Key**: not required
- **Base Url**: usually `http://localhost:11434/v1` for local runs or `http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1` for Docker{docker_hint}
- **Model Name**: required; run `ollama list` and enter an installed model, such as `qwen:7b`
Translation.llm_provider_tips.claude_code:
##### Claude Code Configuration
- **API Key**: not required; the local `claude` CLI authenticates with your Claude subscription (Pro / Max / Team)
- **Base Url**: not required
- **Model Name**: optional; leave empty to use the CLI default, or set `claude-opus-5` / `claude-sonnet-5`
- **Claude CLI Path**: optional; leave empty to resolve `claude` from PATH
- Requires the CLI to be installed and logged in where MoneyPrinterTurbo runs. In Docker, pass a `claude setup-token` token as `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`
- Requests use your Claude subscription usage limits. Conflicting `ANTHROPIC_*` / `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_*` environment variables are stripped before the CLI runs, so an API key in the environment cannot silently bill your API account
Translation.llm_provider_tips.ollama.docker_hint: > Container environment detected. If Base Url is empty, `http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1` is used by default.
Translation.llm_provider_tips.openai:
##### OpenAI Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on the [OpenAI Platform]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`; enter another endpoint when using a compatible service
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another model ID available to your account
> Accessing the official service may require a network proxy in some regions

When selected, LoomLoom script and video generation automatically reuse this API Key.

Translation.llm_provider_tips.moonshot:
##### Kimi / Moonshot Configuration
- **API Key**: register through the [MoneyPrinterTurbo link (10% bonus API credit on your first top-up)]({api_key_url}) and create one in the console
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; see the [model list]({model_docs_url})

Why recommended:
- **Fits the video creation workflow**: helps generate scripts, extract stock-footage search keywords, and improve final footage relevance
- **Strong long-context capability**: useful for longer topics, batch scripts, and complex prompts
- **Exclusive offer for new users**: receive bonus API credit equal to 10% of the first successful top-up, up to CNY 1,000; offer ends September 30, 2026

- **Account ID**: enter your Cloudflare account ID

- **Base Url**: not required; the REST API endpoint is generated from the Account ID
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; use the `provider/model` format for another model supported by AI Gateway

Make sure the API Key and Base Url belong to the same platform, or authentication may fail.
Translation.llm_provider_tips.pollinations:
##### Pollinations AI Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on [Pollinations]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another model ID from the [model catalog](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models) that supports Chat Completions
Translation.LoomLoom Video Terms Reuse Help: LoomLoom script candidates already include video terms. Select a candidate or edit the terms below; no separate local LLM call is needed.
Translation.Shengsuan Cloud AI Video Help: Generate 1–5 paid AI video clips through the current LoomLoom video Listing. Models are loaded from the authenticated capability profile. Review and confirm the quote before using the existing narration, subtitle, and editing pipeline.
Translation.AI Video Model Reference Price: Reference price: {price}, for guidance only. Final charges are based on actual model usage.
Translation.AI Video Model List Load Failed: Could not load the video model list: {error}
Translation.Selected AI Video Model Unavailable: The selected model is no longer available. Refresh the model list, choose another model, and get a new quote.
Translation.Selected AI Video Ratio Unavailable: The selected aspect ratio is not supported by the current video capability profile.
Translation.AI Video Quote Estimate Incomplete: A complete cost estimate is not currently available. Charges may still apply; final billing is based on actual model usage.
Translation.Confirm AI Video Charge: I understand that AI video generation is a paid service
Translation.Confirm AI Video Charge Help: Execution uses the Listing version returned by this quote and a stable idempotency key. The final charge is based on actual model usage and may be nonzero even when the estimate is incomplete.
Translation.AI Video Quote Required: Get a current Shengsuan Cloud AI video quote before generating the video.
Translation.Confirm AI Video Charge Required: Confirm the Shengsuan Cloud AI video charge before generating the video.
Translation.AI Video Quote Retained For Retry: Generation failed, but the confirmed quote was retained. You can retry safely with the same request or request a new quote.
Translation.LoomLoom Poll Retry Pending: The service is temporarily unavailable. Retrying in {seconds} seconds...
Translation.LoomLoom Poll Retry Warning: The service is temporarily unavailable. Status check {attempt}/{max_attempts} failed and will retry automatically.
Translation.Stop Tracking LoomLoom Run Help: Stops local status checks only. It does not cancel a paid run that may still be active on Shengsuan Cloud.
Translation.llm_provider_tips.litellm:
##### LiteLLM Configuration
- **API Key**: not entered here; configure the target Provider key through environment variables
- **Base Url**: not required
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; use the `provider/model` format and see the [Provider list](https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/providers)
Translation.Automatically publish generated videos t: Automatically publish generated videos to social media using upload-post.com
Translation.Upload-Post API Key Help: Create and copy an API key on the [Upload-Post API Keys page]({api_keys_url}).
Translation.Upload-Post Profile Username Help: Enter the Username shown on [Manage Users]({manage_users_url}), not your Upload-Post account email. This publishing user must be connected to the selected platforms.
Translation.Upload-Post Setup Guide:
Before enabling auto-publish:
1. Create an API key on [API Keys]({api_keys_url}).
2. Create or select a publishing user on [Manage Users]({manage_users_url}), then connect the target platforms.

Enter that publishing user's **Username** below, not your Upload-Post account email.
Translation.OFox AI Video Help: One key for multi-model video creation, with direct access to official model providers. Pay as you go—stable, fast, and unlimited.
Translation.OFox Billing Notice: Each generated clip is billed by OFox. Based on the estimated voiceover duration and clip duration, roughly {min}-{max} paid task(s) will be submitted. Generation stops as soon as enough footage is collected.
Translation.OFox Billing Notice Without Script: Each generated clip is billed by OFox. Enter or generate the video script to see an estimated task count.
Translation.Confirm OFox Charge: I understand OFox video generation creates paid tasks
Translation.Confirm OFox Charge Help: OFox clips are submitted one at a time and stop once they cover the voiceover duration. OFox bills each submitted generation task.
Translation.Confirm OFox Charge Required: Please confirm the OFox charge before generating the video.
Translation.OFox Upstream Vendor Help: Which upstream vendor serves OFox video generation. BytePlus (international) is the default with a consistent content policy; Volcano Engine is the mainland-China vendor; Auto lets the OFox gateway load-balance across vendors.
Translation.Codex Default Model Help: Leave blank to use Codex's current default model.
Translation.Codex Auth Unavailable: Codex ChatGPT authentication is unavailable. Run the local login command below in the environment running MoneyPrinterTurbo.
Translation.Codex Login Help: Sign in using your ChatGPT account on the host running MoneyPrinterTurbo. Subscription limits apply.
Translation.Codex Headless Login Help: For a headless server, append --device-auth. Then refresh authentication here.
Translation.Codex Production Help: Codex plans scenes and reviews materials and renders. MoneyPrinterTurbo runs the media pipeline. Your selected media and voice providers keep their own settings and charges.
Translation.Codex Repair Limit Help: Zero keeps reviews but disables automatic repair attempts.
Translation.Codex Render Review Scope: Final review checks the full video and audio files for technical problems, and Codex reviews sampled frames for visual quality. Technical checks do not verify every spoken word or replace listening to the finished video.
Translation.Built-in Visuals Help: Create charts, diagrams, text cards and icon compositions locally with Codex. Add screenshots below when your video needs them. No stock or image-generation API key is needed; ChatGPT subscription limits and your selected voice or music provider still apply.
Translation.Built-in Visuals Require Codex: Choose Codex under Production Intelligence to use built-in visuals.
Translation.llm_provider_tips.codex:
##### Codex subscription configuration
- Uses the official OpenAI Codex SDK and your local ChatGPT sign-in.
- No API key or Base URL is required. Blank model follows the current Codex default.
- Subscription-only authentication: API-key environment variables are isolated for Codex calls.
- Production Intelligence is configured separately in the script panel.
Translation.Caption-first search help: Search discovers metadata and captions before downloading video. Timestamp results identify matching source evidence.
Translation.Search optional model help: Optional models must be enabled and installed in search settings. Disabled capabilities are skipped.
Translation.Collection saved: Collection saved. Refresh the library to select it.
Translation.Discovery captions only help: Submit a URL from your configured approved domains. Discovery fetches metadata and captions without downloading full video.
Translation.Discovery queued: Discovery queued. Processing status appears below.
Translation.Metadata registration help: Register supplied metadata when captions are unavailable. Metadata matches do not establish a timestamped demonstration.
Translation.Source rights help: Record the permission or license that covers the intended use. Internal review permission alone does not allow using a clip in generated exports.
Translation.Rights review fields required: Enter the permission reason and reviewer identity.
Translation.Metadata evidence range help: This match comes from title or description. Choose and review a real source range before approving extraction; discover the source duration first if needed.
Translation.Confirm selected range relevance: I reviewed this range and confirm it demonstrates the requested content.
Translation.Clip extraction queued: Clip extraction queued. Processing status appears below.
Translation.No video evidence found: No matching evidence found. Discover sources or try different terms.
Translation.Clip generation export rights required: Generation requires current permission for generated exports. Review source rights before attaching this clip.
Translation.Targeted search disabled: Targeted clip search is disabled in configuration.
Translation.Search clips generation help: Review and download exact source moments here. Clips attached to generation follow your existing clip duration, speed, and ordering settings.
Translation.Import timed source captions: Import timed source captions (VTT, SRT or JSON)
Translation.Source captions indexed: Source captions indexed. Search the library to find their evidence.
Translation.Authorized transcription help: Audio transcription needs a relevant approved candidate, source analysis permission, and an installed local speech model.
Translation.Select collection before discovery: Select or create a collection before discovering a playlist or channel.
Translation.Collection discovery queued: {count} selected sources queued for caption discovery. No video was downloaded.
Translation.Case import summary: Imported {imported}, unchanged {unchanged}, updated {updated}, skipped {skipped}. Review rights before indexing or export.
Translation.Case originals help: Import the original source files here. Production scripts, narration, and effects stay separate from factual evidence.
Translation.Claims review help: Retain supporting and conflicting citations. Reviewed claims need a named reviewer and source evidence; production drafts do not substantiate case facts.
Translation.Confirm word timing asset binding: I confirm these words align to the selected audio and script.
Translation.Event date uncertainty help: Enter the supplied date or time and select its precision. Leave it blank when unknown; explain uncertainty in notes.
Translation.Explicit storyboard binding help: Assign each scene an exact asset, source range or page, and evidence references. Scene order is explicit. Original sound and final narration are separate audio roles.
Translation.Independent modality ranking help: Footage and supporting evidence have separate result rankings. Production drafts are excluded by default. A search match does not verify a claim.
Translation.Narration timestamps require script: Select the script asset used to align the final narration.
Translation.Word timestamps must be a JSON object: Word timestamps must be a JSON object
Translation.Word timestamps JSON required: Upload or select a word timestamps JSON file.
Translation.Word timing binding help: Select the recording and script that the JSON actually aligns to. Your confirmation pins their hashes; supplied mismatched hashes are rejected. Unknown word times remain unknown.
Translation.Linked source original not acquired: This linked source has no acquired original yet. Complete authorized acquisition before refreshing.
Translation.Prepared case folder help: Place your original files in the matching folders below, then import. Preparation creates folders and the current case inventory; it does not create evidence files.
Translation.Continuous narration timing help: Continuous narration pauses during original-sound scenes, then resumes. The whole narration take must fit the total duration of the other scenes. When aligned word timings are supplied, the provenance export maps them to output times.
Translation.Documentary source has no indexed text: This source has no indexed text. Review the original before making a factual claim.
Translation.Documentary generation queued: Documentary writing job queued. Refresh this view after the job completes.
Translation.Documentary evidence provider help: Select reviewed claims to build the documentary. Generating an outline, narration or factual review sends the selected retained evidence to the text provider configured in Settings.
Translation.Documentary reviewed evidence required: Add reviewed claims with retained source citations in Timeline / Claims before writing a documentary.
Translation.Documentary revision saved: Draft revision saved. Run factual review again before approval.
Translation.Documentary human review help: Review each passage against its cited source and resolve evidence gaps before approving. AI review does not replace your factual judgment. Editing a draft clears its approval.
Translation.Documentary production handoff help: The approved script is imported as a production asset for rights review. Production lets you bind footage, original sound and narration explicitly; footage requirements remain search leads.
Translation.Documentary drafts will appear here: Generated outlines and narration drafts will appear here.
Translation.Documentary evidence changed: The source evidence changed or permission was revoked. Rebuild the documentary from current reviewed evidence.
Translation.Documentary original sound separate help: Narrator text is shown without citation markers. Original source quotes remain separately identified in the cited draft and footage requirements.
Translation.Documentary narration requires draft: Write the narration draft to preview spoken text.
Translation.Acoustic confirm reviewed sound plan: I reviewed all enabled cues and their sound effects
Translation.Acoustic anchor word boundary: Effect alignment at the anchored word
Translation.Acoustic analysis queued: Suggesting sound cues. The result will appear here when it is ready.
Translation.Acoustic mix review help: Review the word anchors, chosen effects and levels. Effects are editorial sound design and do not represent original scene audio. Rendering preserves the narration timing and exports a mix plus editable timeline files.
Translation.Acoustic unmatched cue disabled: No matching sound effect. Select a permitted effect before enabling this cue.
Translation.Acoustic no sound cues: This plan has no sound cues.
Translation.Acoustic plans will appear here: Generated sound plans will appear here.
Translation.Acoustic align narration if needed: Align narration if timestamps are missing
Translation.Acoustic import sound effects first: Import WAV sound effects in Library to register them here.
Translation.Acoustic sound registration help: Import WAV sound effects through Library and register descriptive tags here. Only explicitly registered, permitted sound effects can match cues. Source recordings cited as evidence cannot become editorial effects.
Translation.Acoustic plan revision saved: Sound plan revised. Review the new version before rendering.
Translation.Acoustic narration alignment help: Choose the recorded narration WAV and its final script. Cues use verified narration word timestamps. Tension analysis sends the aligned script to the text provider configured in Settings.
Translation.Acoustic narration and script required: Import a narration WAV and a final script in Library before analyzing sound cues.
Translation.Acoustic alignment required: Bind narration word timestamps in Production, or enable automatic alignment with the locally configured alignment model.
Translation.Acoustic source inputs changed: The narration, script, alignment or sound effect changed. Rebuild the plan from current assets.
Translation.Acoustic editorial confirmation required: Confirm this WAV is an editorial sound effect before registering it.
Translation.Acoustic confirm editorial effect: This WAV is an editorial sound effect
Translation.Acoustic estimated tension help: Tension scores are AI estimates. Cue times come from verified narration word timestamps.
Translation.Workspace footage help: Find relevant source moments, review the evidence, and choose the footage for your edit.
Translation.Workspace sources help: Keep the original case files together. Import sources, find passages, and review permission to use them.
Translation.Workspace facts help: Review what the sources support before turning it into narration. Keep uncertain claims visible.
Translation.Workspace edit help: Build your scene order from selected footage and narration, then export the edit.
Translation.Choose a case help: Select a case above, or create one to collect sources, review facts, write a script, and design its sound. You can still search the shared footage library.
Translation.First documentary case help: Create a case to keep footage, legal records, narration, and sound work together. Use the footage library below to explore sources.
Translation.Case readiness summary: Retained sources: {retained} · Footage leads: {footage_leads} · Reviewed claims: {reviewed_claims}
Translation.Workspace navigation help: Move between stages as your case develops. Footage stays separate from source evidence.
Translation.Footage search placeholder: A person, place, event, or scene…
Translation.Footage search starting help: Search a name or scene. Results show what was said or described and where it appears; review the original before choosing a clip.
Translation.Documentary writing desk help: Turn reviewed evidence into narration. Read the script, resolve factual issues, then approve the version you want to produce.
Translation.Documentary next draft help: The outline is ready. Write the narration from its reviewed evidence.
Translation.Documentary next fact check help: The draft is ready. Check every passage against its retained sources before approval.
Translation.Documentary next approval help: The fact check supports every passage. Review the narration and source evidence before approving this version.
Translation.Documentary next export help: This version is approved. Export the production script and its source references.
Translation.Documentary fact check blockers: Some passages lack support or contradict their sources. Edit those passages, then run the fact check again. Approval is unavailable until every passage is supported.
Translation.Documentary review draft export help: You can export a review draft now. The production script becomes available after the fact check and editorial approval.
Translation.Documentary revision requested help: The reviewer requested changes. Edit the draft using their notes, then run the fact check again.
Translation.Acoustic choose word timing: Choose a different word timing file
Translation.Acoustic align and suggest cues: Align words and suggest sound cues
Translation.Acoustic unmatched summary: Some cues need a matching sound. They remain skipped until you choose one below.
Translation.Acoustic editing files help: Use these files to continue editing the timed cues in your video workflow.
Translation.Acoustic workspace help: Listen to the finished mix, review timed sound cues, or start from a recorded narration.
Translation.Acoustic render another mix: Render another mix of this plan
Translation.Acoustic rebuild guidance: Open “Start a new sound plan” below and select the current narration and script. Word timing and effects must match those files.
Translation.Evidence source changed: This source has changed since the citation was saved.
Translation.Timeline empty help: Add an event, record how precise its date is, and attach the evidence that supports it.
Translation.Timeline source changed help: An event source has changed. Check its citations before using this date in your script.
Translation.Case facts empty help: Find and save source evidence in Sources, then add a fact here with its citations. Reviewed facts become available to the script writer.
Translation.Fact source changed help: A source has changed. Review this fact and its citations before using it in your script.
Translation.Case library empty help: No source files have been added to this case. Import an existing case folder below, or link footage you found in Footage Search.
Translation.Case folder setup help: Create the legal, audio, footage, stills, and production folders if you need a new workspace. To add files you already have, enter their folder path and import the originals.
Translation.Case indexing help: Select files to extract document text, audio transcripts, and visual search data. Importing originals does not start indexing.
Translation.Production empty help: Start with a working script and selected footage. Open “Build or adjust scenes” below to add footage, documents, photos, or source audio; then save the edit and render it.
Translation.Documentary reviewed claims need evidenc: Some reviewed statements are not ready for narration. Use Facts & timeline to resolve the issues below.
Translation.Documentary claim classification require: Classify this statement using its cited source. Unclassified statements and editorial notes cannot support narration.
Translation.Documentary claim supporting evidence re: Attach at least one supporting citation. Citations that only oppose or mention the statement do not support narration.
Translation.Documentary claim current citations requ: Update stale citations to the current retained source version.
Translation.Documentary claim reviewer required: Enter the reviewer’s name for this statement.
Translation.Documentary duration help: Target 22–28 minutes, starting at 25. Measure the final runtime after narration and editing.
Translation.Documentary narration estimate help: Target: {min_minutes}–{max_minutes} minutes. Estimate: {words_per_minute} spoken words per minute. Recorded audio and editing determine the final runtime.
Translation.Documentary narration estimate unavailab: Target: {min_minutes}–{max_minutes} minutes. A narration-time estimate is available for English drafts only. Measure the final runtime after recording and editing.
Translation.Documentary narration estimate outside b: Estimated narration is {minutes:.2f} minutes, outside the {min_minutes}–{max_minutes} minute target. Review the script length before recording.
Translation.Documentary other case jobs help: These jobs belong to other scripts, earlier versions, or separate attempts. Their status does not describe this saved script.
